title: Contract tests of a plugin (plugin.test.yaml)
description: Mirrors internal/core/plugintest.go: the loader rejects unknown fields (yaml KnownFields), and this schema describes the same contract for humans and for the schemas gate. services is the declarative environment hook: today only a local HTTP server over a fixture directory, nothing that runs an arbitrary command.

services.description: Optional. Prepared once per run, before the first test case. A file without services behaves exactly as before.

type.description: Only http is supported. Anything else is an error, never a silent skip.

root.description: Directory served as-is, resolved against the plugin directory. Checked before the first test case: a missing root or a file instead of a directory stops the run.

base_url.description: Template that declares the placeholder name(s) the service URL is substituted under. Defaults to {{base_url}} when omitted. Must contain at least one {{name}} token.

env.description: Environment for the duration of the case. {{name}} placeholders are substituted in values.

input.description: JSON object on stdin. {{name}} placeholders are substituted in strings at any depth, including inside nested objects and arrays.

input_raw.description: Raw stdin, for malformed-JSON cases. {{name}} placeholders are substituted here too.

output.description: Expected field values: a literal (deep equality) or a matcher {equals|contains|type|present|absent}.
